summary: Smoke test of freshly-imported Rumah KORPRI passed. Landing renders with hero, nav (Dokumentasi/Masuk/Daftar), and Simulasi CTA. Backend /api/ health OK ({'message':'Rumah KORPRI API aktif'}). Admin login (admin@rumahkorpri.com/korpri123) via UI lands on /crm dashboard with 'Berhasil masuk' toast. Consumer login (consumer@rumahkorpri.com/consumer123) lands on /portal. Public KPR simulate endpoint returns valid schedule. Seeded projects (Griya KORPRI Harmoni Bekasi, and a Depok komersial) visible in public project listing with unit counts (3/5, 3/4). No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a large monolith with many routes; consider splitting into routers per resource for maintainability (not blocking).
Landing 'Simulasi KPR' is an in-page anchor (#simulasi) rather than a dedicated PublicSimulation.js route — check whether that page component is dead code or needs to be wired to a route.
seed_data_creation: Seed ran on startup — 2 projects (Bekasi FLPP, Depok Komersial) with units; 4 users seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App boots cleanly on this fresh import. Backend on 8001, frontend on 3000, external URL https://rumah-deps.preview.emergentagent.com. KPR simulate expects body {price, dp_percent, tenor_years, program} (NOT harga_rumah/tenor_tahun). Twilio WhatsApp intentionally in simulasi mode. All 4 seeded roles available for deeper testing.
